chk_coupons_usable_before_expiry.name: chk_coupons_usable_before_expiry
chk_coupons_usable_before_expiry.value: "coupons"."usable_from" is null or "coupons"."expires_on" is null or ("coupons"."usable_from" at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date <= "coupons"."expires_on"

uq_stamp_balance_unit_store_id.name: uq_stamp_balance_unit_store_id
uq_stamp_balance_unit_store_id.where: "stamp_balances"."deleted_at" is null and "stamp_balances"."brand_program_id" is not null and "stamp_balances"."purpose" is not null and "stamp_balances"."accrual_scope" <> 'unknown' and "stamp_balances"."store_id" is not null

uq_stamp_balance_unit_store_name.name: uq_stamp_balance_unit_store_name
uq_stamp_balance_unit_store_name.where: "stamp_balances"."deleted_at" is null and "stamp_balances"."brand_program_id" is not null and "stamp_balances"."purpose" is not null and "stamp_balances"."accrual_scope" <> 'unknown' and "stamp_balances"."store_name_raw" is not null

uq_stamp_balance_unidentified.name: uq_stamp_balance_unidentified

chk_stamp_balances_store_scope.name: chk_stamp_balances_store_scope
chk_stamp_balances_store_scope.value: ("stamp_balances"."store_id" is null and "stamp_balances"."store_name_raw" is null) or "stamp_balances"."accrual_scope" = 'store'

chk_stamp_balances_unidentified_key.name: chk_stamp_balances_unidentified_key
